items.meaning: A session is a set of multimedia senders and receivers and the data streams flowing from senders to receivers; if SDP is used, it is defined by the concatenation of SDP origin-field elements.

items.meaning: 把 dialog 之外的出站请求发送到 pre-existing route set 所标识服务器链的用户代理客户端
出站代理，provider 为 UA 配置时推荐用单 URI 的 pre-existing route set 指向它
items.constraint: 当 provider 希望为 UA 配置出站代理时，推荐通过提供只含单个 URI（即该出站代理的 URI）的 pre-existing route set 来完成
items.object: a pre-existing route set with a single URI, that of the outbound proxy
items.condition: When a provider wishes to configure a UA with an outbound proxy

items.meaning: 当存在 pre-existing route set 时，请求中需要填充的 Request-URI
items.constraint: 存在 pre-existing route set 时，必须遵循 Section 12.2.1.1 中填充 Request-URI 与 Route 头域的过程
items.object: the procedures for populating the Request-URI and Route header field detailed in Section 12.2.1.1
items.condition: When a pre-existing route set is present

items.meaning: To 头域，用于指定请求期望的“逻辑”接收者或作为请求目标的用户/资源的 address-of-record
To 头域可携带 SIP 或 SIPS URI，也可适当使用其他 URI 方案
items.constraint: To 头域可以包含 SIP 或 SIPS URI

items.meaning: SIP URI 方案，所有 SIP 实现都必须支持
items.constraint: 所有 SIP 实现必须支持 SIP URI 方案

items.meaning: SIPS URI 方案，支持 TLS 的实现必须支持
items.constraint: 任何支持 TLS 的实现必须支持 SIPS URI 方案

items.meaning: 发起请求并填充 To 头域的 user agent client。
items.constraint: A UAC may learn how to populate the To header field for a particular request in a number of ways
items.object: the To header field for a particular request

items.meaning: 当 UA 不希望指定解释用户输入的电话号码的域时，可以使用的标识方式。
items.constraint: The tel URL may be used when the UA does not wish to specify the domain that should interpret a telephone number that has been input by the user
items.condition: when the UA does not wish to specify the domain that should interpret a telephone number that has been input by the user

items.meaning: To 头域中的 tag 参数，用于标识对话的对端。
items.constraint: A request outside of a dialog MUST NOT contain a To tag

items.meaning: 关于 To 头域的进一步信息可参见第 20.39 节。
指示请求发起方的逻辑身份，可能是用户的 address-of-record，包含 URI 以及可选的显示名。
From 头域中的 URI，用于表明请求发起方的逻辑身份。
items.constraint: it is very important that the From URI not contain IP addresses or the FQDN of the host on which the UA is running
items.object: IP addresses or the FQDN of the host on which the UA is running
items.keyword_raw: it is very important that ... not

items.meaning: 发起请求的 user agent client，在需要隐藏客户端身份时使用显示名并构造 URI。
items.constraint: A UAC SHOULD use the display name "Anonymous", along with a syntactically correct, but otherwise meaningless URI (like sip:thisis@anonymous.invalid), if the identity of the client is to remain hidden
items.object: the display name "Anonymous", along with a syntactically correct, but otherwise meaningless URI (like sip:thisis@anonymous.invalid)
items.condition: if the identity of the client is to remain hidden

items.meaning: 请求中 From 头域的值通常由用户或用户本地域管理员预置
From 头域必须包含由 UAC 选定的新 tag 参数
items.constraint: The From field MUST contain a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC
items.object: a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC

items.meaning: 有关 From 头域的进一步信息参见第 20.20 节
Call-ID 头域用作把一系列消息归组的唯一标识符
在对话中该 UA 收发的所有请求与响应中，Call-ID 头域必须相同
items.constraint: It MUST be the same for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog
items.object: for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog
items.condition: sent by either UA in a dialog

items.meaning: UA 的每次注册中 Call-ID 头域应保持相同
items.constraint: It SHOULD be the same in each registration from a UA
items.object: in each registration from a UA
items.condition: in each registration from a UA

items.meaning: UAC 在无对话的新请求中必须把 Call-ID 头域选为在时空上全局唯一的标识符
items.constraint: the Call-ID header field MUST be selected by the UAC as a globally unique identifier over space and time
items.object: the Call-ID header field as a globally unique identifier over space and time
items.condition: In a new request created by a UAC outside of any dialog

items.meaning: 所有 SIP UA 必须有办法保证其所产生的 Call-ID 头域不会被任何其它 UA 无意生成
items.constraint: All SIP UAs must have a means to guarantee that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA
items.object: that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA

items.meaning: 因请求修正类失败响应而重试的请求不被视为新请求，因此不需要新的 Call-ID 头字段。
items.constraint: 重试请求不需要新的 Call-ID 头字段

items.meaning: 在生成 Call-ID 时使用密码学随机标识符是 RECOMMENDED。
items.constraint: Use of cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED
items.object: cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs

items.meaning: 实现 MAY 使用 "localid@host" 形式。
items.constraint: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host"

items.meaning: Call-ID 区分大小写，并逐字节比较。
items.constraint: Call-IDs are case-sensitive and are compared byte-by-byte

items.meaning: 选择请求的 Call-ID 头字段值不需要配置或人工界面。
items.constraint: No provisioning or human interface is required for the selection of the Call-ID header field value for a request

items.meaning: 关于 Call-ID 头字段的更多信息见 Section 20.8。
CSeq 头字段用于标识和排序事务，并由序列号和方法组成。
CSeq 中的方法 MUST 与请求的方法匹配。
items.constraint: The method MUST match that of the request

items.meaning: 对于对话外的非 REGISTER 请求，序列号值是任意的。
items.constraint: For non-REGISTER requests outside of a dialog, the sequence number value is arbitrary

items.meaning: 序列号值 MUST 能表示为 32 位无符号整数。
items.constraint: The sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer

items.meaning: 序列号值 MUST 小于 2**31。
items.constraint: The sequence number value MUST be less than 2**31

items.meaning: 只要遵循上述准则，客户端 MAY 使用其希望的任何机制来选择 CSeq 头字段值。
items.constraint: a client may use any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values
items.object: any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values
items.condition: As long as it follows the above guidelines

key_manifest.note: ★ 「缓存命中时产物可复现」可保证；★ 「重新调用同一模型能否逐字节相同」**不一定成立**
